title: Compatible trivializations of finite derived local systems
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $(B_n)_{n\geq1}$ an inverse sequence of finite commutative rings with surjective maps $q_n:B_{n+1}\to B_n$. Let $K_n\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},B_n)$ and $E_n\in D(B_n)$ be bounded complexes with finite locally constant cohomology and finite module cohomology respectively [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Supply normalization isomorphisms $\rho_n:K_{n+1}\otimes^L_{B_{n+1}}B_n\simeq K_n$ and $\eta_n:E_{n+1}\otimes^L_{B_{n+1}}B_n\simeq E_n$, with their quotient cocycles [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Assume the sheaf of derived isomorphisms $\mathcal I_n=\operatorname{Isom}(\underline E_n,K_n)$, defined by sheafifying isomorphisms on etale localized sites, is finite locally constant and has nonempty stalks. Reduction defines $r_n:\mathcal I_{n+1}\to\mathcal I_n$ by $e\mapsto\rho_n\circ(e\otimes^L B_n)\circ\underline{\eta_n}^{-1}$. Then there is a pro-etale covering $\{U_j\to X\}_j$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and isomorphisms $e_{jn}:\underline E_n|_{U_j}\simeq\nu_X^*K_n|_{U_j}$ such that $r_n(e_{j,n+1})=e_{jn}$ for all $n$. Here the displayed constant complexes and reduction maps are pulled to the pro-etale site by [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. No surjectivity of the original $r_n$ is required.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-normalized-derived-isomorphism-section-reduction] to obtain reduction morphisms r_n obeying the normalization square for the canonical, separately constructed sourceDerivedIsoEvaluation.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-lisse-tower-section-cover] to the finite lisse local Isom sheaves, their reduction morphisms, and the supplied nonempty geometric stalks. Package its Type u covering family as Scheme.Cover.

Evaluate its sections on each affine weakly contractible covering object. Substitute the section compatibility into the normalization/evaluation square. This is precisely the stated equation, with the original canonical maps.
